sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.note: Base venue skeleton — paths, buildings, attractions, amenities — pulled via Overpass API queries and processed by the venue builder. Every shipped venue (apps/party-tracker/public/venues/*.map.json, *.pois.json) is built from this. Adapters: packages/venue-builder/lib/adapters/registry.mjs (osm, overpass-api).

sources.name: Overture Maps Foundation — Buildings theme
sources.note: Deduplicated OSM + Microsoft ML + Google Open Buildings footprints; published under ODbL specifically because the theme includes OSM-derived data. Opt-in adapter (packages/venue-builder/lib/adapters/overture-buildings.mjs) — excluded from the default source set (packages/venue-builder/lib/venue-sources.mjs) and not run for the four shipped venues today, so it carries no on-map badge of its own; it shares the OSM on-map notice's ODbL coverage when it is used.

sources.name: ESA WorldCover
sources.note: Global 10 m land-cover classification (packages/venue-builder/lib/adapters/esa-worldcover.mjs). Used today as an aerial evidence cross-check in the publish pipeline (validates entrance/land claims before they ship) and as Display-layer land-tone input for the pre-release MapLibre Display pipeline (issue #527, off by default). Verify the exact recommended credit-line wording against esa-worldcover.org before this line ships outside the Credits screen — this session had no network access to confirm it against the source.

sources.name: USGS 3DEP
sources.note: Bare-earth elevation for US venues, 1/3 arc-second (~10 m) seamless DTM, lidar-derived (packages/venue-builder/lib/adapters/usgs-3dep.mjs). Feeds only the pre-release Display factory's terrain baking (packages/venue-builder/lib/terrain/dem-source.mjs) — not the shipped truth layer. Public domain: no attribution is legally required; credited here as courtesy.

sources.name: Okaloosa County 2025 orthophotography
sources.credit: Okaloosa County GIS 2025 orthophotography, flown by Pictometry International Corp (EagleView), served via Esri World Imagery
sources.note: Aerial basis for Big Kahuna's Destin: walking paths OpenStreetMap does not draw, and ride positions where OSM names geometry but not the attraction (packages/venue-builder/data/venues/big-kahunas/imagery.geojson). No imagery bytes ship — what ships is hand-surveyed vector geometry read off the imagery, and the ledger row carries path: null and sha256: null accordingly. The serving channel is named here on purpose: this survey was made through Esri World Imagery, and the owner ruled (2026-08-29) that the record states the channel actually used rather than being rewritten to a compliant one after the fact — a survey record that is corrected retroactively is falsified, not fixed. Okaloosa County serves the same programme directly at the url above, which is the admissible channel for any future re-survey or ingest. LICENCE IS UNRESOLVED and is not to be inferred: the raster is a Pictometry (EagleView) vendor product the county licensed in, not a county work; Okaloosa GIS publishes its public-domain notice on vector items only and every imagery service returns an empty licenseInfo; Florida Chapter 119 grants access, not redistribution over a third party's raster. Open with webgis@myokaloosa.com. Full adjudication: packages/venue-builder/data/imagery-ledger.json, and docs/adr/0020-imagery-ground-truth.md clause 2.

sources.name: Queue-Times.com
sources.license: Data used under Queue-Times.com Terms of Service
sources.note: Back-office wait-time cross-check used only during venue certification (packages/venue-builder/lib/adapters/queue-times.mjs, packages/venue-builder/lib/venue-certify.mjs). Confirmed: no shipped apps/party-tracker/public/venues/*.json bundle carries queue-times-derived data — it never reaches guests, so it is credited here as a back-office acknowledgement only. If a future feature displays live Queue-Times wait times to guests, that surface's ToS requires a "Powered by Queue-Times" link at the point of display, and this row's attribution mode must change to placed-link at that location.

sources.name: Kenney (kenney.nl)
sources.note: Roguelike/RPG, RPG Urban, and Roguelike Modern City spritesheet packs (packages/venue-builder/data/display/assets.json) for the pre-release Display factory. CC0 — attribution appreciated, not required; credited here as courtesy.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.note: PBR material sets (packages/venue-builder/data/display/materials.json) for the pre-release Display factory.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.note: PBR material ledger (packages/venue-builder/data/display/polyhaven-materials.json) for the pre-release Display factory — texture bytes are fetched at build time and never committed.

sources.name: MapLibre GL JS
sources.note: WebGL vector-tile map renderer. Confirmed via node_modules/maplibre-gl/package.json ("license": "BSD-3-Clause"); the venue-builder's adapter registry (packages/venue-builder/lib/adapters/registry.mjs) agrees (#565).

sources.name: PMTiles
sources.note: Single-file tiled archive format for the map tile pipeline. Confirmed via node_modules/pmtiles/package.json ("license": "BSD-3-Clause").

sources.name: Tippecanoe
sources.note: GeoJSON → vector tiles. Not invoked automatically by the builder — packages/venue-builder/lib/tiles-export.mjs writes a shell recipe (tippecanoe.sh) for a maintainer to run by hand; still credited because the shipped tile pipeline depends on its output.
